Application 
Application 
Procedure 
Guest university should compile the application profile of all students interested 
(including all mandatory and optional documents) and send a nomination letter 
via email to one of the contacts above. 
Required 
Documents 
Mandatory 
1. An official list of nominated students 
2. A Letter of Nomination 
3. A curriculum vitae 
4. Full academic transcript in English 
5. A photocopy of passport (identification page with 
applicant’s photo and name) 
Optional 1. A portrait photo in JPG format 
2. Certificate of English language proficiency (B2 or above)

Course Information 
Language 
of 
Instruction 
English 
Course List 
Academic programs: https://fae-en.hcmute.edu.vn/  
Students can pick courses based on their major and credit requirements. 
The final course list will be reviewed by HCM -UTE’s Faculty of Advanced 
Education to check for availability. 
Limitation/ 
Suggestion on 
Course 
Selection 
Students must complete at least 1 course (min 2 ETCs) per academic term. 
Students should choose no more than 4 courses per academic term to avoid 
scheduling conflict and overload. 
 
 
Administrative Fee & Tuition fee 
Administration Fee 
for Visiting Student 
We only accept exchange students from universities or educational 
organizations with an exisiting student exchange agreement with HCM-UTE. 
 
Exchange students under a student exchange agreement will be exempt  from 
tuition fee & administrative fee.

Accommodation 
On-Campus 
Accommodation 
Student Dormitory D1 
3-4 students/room,  
Fee: around USD 1,195 per academic year 
Campus Guesthouse 
Single room: USD 192 per month 
Twin room: USD 306 per month (USD 153 per person) 
Triple room: USD 384 per month (USD 128 per person) 
Off-Campus 
Dormitory 
Student Dormitory D2 
(4 km from campus) 
3-4 students/room,  
Fee: around USD 925 per academic year 
8 students/room,  
Fee: around USD 221 per academic year 
If students don’t want to share a room with others, the Office of International 
Affairs can help them to find an off-campus room. 
Accommodation information for exchange students: https://www.facebook.com/ktxhcmute  
Other Fees and Expenses 
 Insurance 
For long -term exchanges, we suggest students acquire travel and health 
insurance which is valid during her/ his exchange period at HCM-UTE. 
 
Students participating in long-term exchange program at HCM-UTE must acquire 
the student Visa for studying abroad. 
 
If students are staying off -campus, make sure the homeowner or hosting 
establishment register your temporary stay declaration with local authorities.
